messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.

Write a practical notice for a fictional neighborhood repair cafe: bring one broken item, take a numbered ticket, and collect it before volunteers leave. Avoid promotional language. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content:
**Neighborhood Repair Café: Visitor Notice**

Bring one broken item per person. Check in at the front table and take a numbered ticket. Keep it until your item is returned.

Volunteers will call numbers in order. Stay nearby, since some repairs need your input or a quick decision.

Not every item can be fixed. Parts may need to be ordered, and some repairs will not be possible.

Collect your item before volunteers leave at 4:30 p.m. Unclaimed items cannot be stored.
